question_types.name: Speaker Gender Recognition
question_types.goal: Identify the speaker's gender from the audio.
question_types.answer_rule: the gender label of the speaker

question_types.name: Dialect Region Recognition
question_types.goal: Identify the speaker's broad dialect region from the audio.
question_types.answer_rule: the broad region label of the voice

question_types.name: Speaker Verification
question_types.goal: Decide whether two recordings come from the same speaker.

question_types.name: Transcription
question_types.goal: Transcribe the spoken content of the audio.
question_types.answer_rule: transcribe the text content of the audio

question_types.name: Province-to-Region Reasoning
question_types.goal: Infer the broad dialect region from the province-level dialect.
question_types.answer_rule: the region that the province belongs to

question_types.name: Utterance Duration Estimation
question_types.goal: Estimate how long the utterance lasts.
question_types.answer_rule: the duration value of the audio

question_types.name: Speaker Age Recognition
question_types.goal: Identify the speaker's age group from the audio.
question_types.answer_rule: the age label of the speaker

question_types.name: Province to Region Mapping
question_types.goal: Map a province label to its broad region from metadata.
question_types.answer_rule: the region that the province belongs to
